harness: Harbor 0.25.0 native Qwen Code 0.26.5; no modified agent loop or added dbt prompt/tools
invalid_attempt_policy: Keep every raw trial. Missing capture/audit, external service or allocation interruption stays unresolved, not a fabricated 0. Only independently established infrastructure failure may be retried in the same planned attempt slot with explicit parent linkage; no replacement of behavioral failures or ordinary task-budget terminations.
native_task_budgets: preserved; record external allocation deadline separately
purpose: difficulty measurement only; prohibited for model training
scope: Only step2 authorized model generations; steps1/3 and CPU audit/reports never invoke a model.

slurm.fallback_partition: gh only with recorded evidence that subdivided gh-dev jobs cannot satisfy a required run

success_definition: Native reward map satisfies its source success rule AND the qualified frozen task audit returns 1 on the actual same agent submission. Native-only counts retained separately. Missing audit or invalid execution is not a success and does not silently become a measured failure.
